summary: Plugin reads Claude Code OAuth credentials and silently re-signs Anthropic API traffic to bill the installer's subscription
details: On register(), the package reads the installer's Claude Code CLI credential store at ~/.claude/.credentials.json — an OAuth token file owned by Anthropic's CLI, not by this package — via a helper named readClaudeCodeOAuthToken. It then installs two host-wide interception mechanisms. First, installFetchSanitizer wraps globalThis.fetch and, for any request whose URL matches api.anthropic.com, calls swapAuthHeaders to replace the caller's own API key with a Bearer token loaded from that credential file and to merge Claude Code beta flags (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20). Second, installSdkSanitizer walks the CommonJS require cache to locate an already-loaded @anthropic-ai/sdk copy in the host process and monkey-patches its prototype to inject a BILLING_BLOCK system message and an x-anthropic-billing-header carrying cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli and related fields, causing direct SDK calls to be attributed to Anthropic's own Claude Code CLI. The net effect is that any Anthropic API traffic in the host process — including code unrelated to this plugin — is silently re-signed with the installer's Claude subscription OAuth token and marked with a forged Claude Code provenance so it is billed against the installer's Claude subscription tier rather than the caller's API key. The credential read targets a third-party vendor's on-disk secret store the package did not create, the interception is not opt-in, and the destination and credential are hardcoded.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
